children: Kuwait's Ministry of Public Works is expected to award a consultancy contract for the Public Authority for Food and Nutrition (PAFN) headquarters project in the first quarter of 2027, according to a source familiar with the details.
The tender was issued on 2 August 2026, with bids due on 13 October 2026.
"The contract is expected to be awarded in January 2027," the source told Zawya Projects, adding that completion is scheduled for the second quarter of 2028.

Local Arabic language newspaper Arab Times had reported in August 2026 that the permanent headquarters includes a building for the Mubarak Al-Kabeer Governorate Inspection Department, a theatre, library, sports facilities, mosque, sample cold storage facilities and a mobile vehicle inspection area. It also includes above-ground and underground parking facilities with a combined capacity of 1,750 vehicles. The report had noted that the bid submission deadline was extended from 30 August to 27 September 2026.
(Reporting by Deva Palanisamy; Editing by Anoop Menon)
